items.question: Which systems can Buzznerd connect?
items.answer: Buzznerd connects your website, inventory providers, CRM, DMS, e-commerce, and marketing platforms — including Karmak and CDK, plus custom DMS and ERP integrations for other third-party systems.

items.question: Can Buzznerd build a workflow specific to how my dealership operates?
items.answer: Yes. Buzznerd builds custom workflows around your operations — inventory and product syncing, lead routing, customer and account workflows, reporting dashboards, and multi-location processes that respect how your rooftops divide the work.

items.question: Will connecting my systems reduce double data entry?
items.answer: Yes. Connected systems mean data flows from your source of record to every channel automatically, so your team spends less time retyping and more time selling, with cleaner, more accurate data.

items.question: Do I need Buzznerd's other products to use integrations?
items.answer: Integrations and workflows work best alongside a Buzznerd website, e-commerce, and the AI platform, but we'll discuss connecting your current systems during a demo.

items.question: How do integrations support AI tools?
items.answer: A clean, connected data foundation is what AI tools build on. When your inventory, leads, and customer data are connected and accurate, AI-connected workflows and assistants can act on reliable information.
